'''Gary''' was an individual who, at one point prior to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], had received a [[Hutt pin-up/Legends|pin-up]] of a voluptuous [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="LTEG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Gary" was included within a message that was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on a pin-up poster of a female Hutt. Displayed on the top-right corner of the image, the message read, "To Gary X0X0."<ref name="LTEG" />

The image was one of several pin-up images seen on the walls of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode, ''[[Lethal Trackdown]]''.<ref name="LT" /> The poster can also be seen in a prison cell in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] in ''[[Deception]]''.
